selection_rule: Wait for both complete pilot arms. Select the lowest final validation loss only if it beats the baseline. Prefer text on exact ties. Freeze selection before seed 42.
no_improvement_action: Save a no-improvement outcome without selecting a false winner. Inspect replay and objective ablations before a new recipe.
fixed_metrics: Paired final loss at 3250 updates; 3.28 target; identical initialization within seed 42; different initialization from seed 17.
limits: Fresh initialization only. Same public validation data. Pilot-based selection and two seeds do not establish a confirmed record.
hardware: spark-a5a1 only; wait for the current GPU queue to complete.
